separate_implementation_finding.independent_phase_5_isolation: The independent implementation includes isolated WorkItems in phase-5 supersession. Phase 1 excludes isolated blocks from cross-block phases, so its additional isolated-block supersession shifts later provenance ordinals independently of the phase-2 defect.
separate_implementation_finding.primary_phase_3_candidate_membership: The primary implementation includes the subject WorkItem in the ordinary phase-3 candidate vector and rejects it after PRF selection. The specification requires every other WorkItem to be the frozen candidate vector, so this is a separate implementation nonconformance that can also change later PRF choices.

specification_defect.component_order: Phase 2 says to partition the remaining blocks into consecutive components but does not name the ordering that defines consecutive.
specification_defect.depends_on_chain_direction: Phase 2 requires a WorkItem depends_on chain but does not define which adjacent WorkItem is the assertion subject and which is the object.
specification_defect.effect: The first phase-2 assertion bytes and IDs differ at construction ordinal 130, before either separately identified implementation nonconformance. This identity-bearing difference alone is sufficient to fail byte-level generator reproduction and demonstrate that the approved phase-2 contract does not determine one canonical snapshot. Later differences are not used as evidence for, or causally attributed to, the contract defect.
